subject: Technical screen: ML Engineer (live coding + debrief) — scheduling
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tamsin Hart <tamsin.hart@acmeai.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentbridge.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical screen: ML Engineer (live coding + debrief) — scheduling

Hi Tamsin / Rebecca,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround — we'd like to schedule the 60-minute live coding + 30-minute debrief for the ML Engineer role. Proposed window: Tuesday 2027-11-09 between 10:30–13:30 PT.

Outline:
- 60 min live coding (CoderPad) with two interviewers (system design + model implementation)
- 30 min debrief with hiring manager and recruiter for next steps

Can you confirm Tamsin's availability in that window? If Friday 11/12 is easier, mention that as an alternative.

I'll loop in ops to provide the CoderPad link and the recording/consent flow once we lock time.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Recruiting Partner (hiring ops)
Redwood Inference

---

From: Tamsin Hart <tamsin.hart@acmeai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:27:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical screen: ML Engineer (live coding + debrief) — scheduling

Hi Jordan,

Tuesday 11/09 works best. Prefer the 11:00–12:30 PT slot if possible (candidate has an overlapping call at 10:45). Friday 11/12 is also open after 11:00 PT.

Happy to confirm once you pick a firm time.

Best,
Tamsin
Principal ML Engineer, Acme AI

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Tamsin Hart <tamsin.hart@acmeai.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical screen: ML Engineer (live coding + debrief) — scheduling

Jordan / team —

If we lock 11:00–12:30 PT on 11/09, interviewer lineup below:
- Kim Park (system design + model tradeoffs) — will take first 30 min and join debrief
- Aditya Rao (implementation + code review) — live coding lead for 60 min
- Monica Patel (hiring manager) — debrief host for 30 min

Ops: please provision CoderPad session and a Zoom meeting with recording enabled (we need candidate consent).

I'll attach the problem set we want on CoderPad and the consent template for signatures.

Attachments: coderpad-problem-set.md; candidate-consent.pdf

Kimberly Park
Senior Recruiting Manager, Redwood Inference

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: recruiting-ops@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Tamsin Hart <tamsin.hart@acmeai.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 11:40:01 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Technical screen: ML Engineer (live coding + debrief) — scheduling

Hi ops — can you provision the following for 2027-11-09 11:00–12:30 PT (coderpad then debrief):
- CoderPad session: use problem set attached (coderpad-problem-set.md). Prefer persistent session so we can capture code after the interview.
- Zoom meeting: please enable cloud recording and add a short pre-call to collect candidate consent. Attach candidate-consent.pdf to the invite.
- Recording retention: tag this meeting as "hiring_interview" retention 90 days.

Links to include in calendar invite (provisioned by ops):
- CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/session/XYZ-abc
- Drive folder with problem & rubric: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Ck-example

Candidate consent: Tamsin, if you can sign the consent form ahead of time that's ideal; if not, we'll get verbal consent on the call and follow up with an e-sign via DocuSign.

Thanks — Jordan

---

From: Tamsin Hart <tamsin.hart@acmeai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 13:04:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical screen: ML Engineer (live coding + debrief) — scheduling

Confirmed: 11/09, 11:00–12:30 PT works. I reviewed the problem set and fine with being recorded; I'll sign the consent form if you send it via DocuSign, otherwise I'll sign the PDF and email it back before the call.

See you then — looking forward to the discussion.

Best,
Tamsin

---

[Attachment stubs]
- coderpad-problem-set.md (text)
- candidate-consent.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

[Thread notes]
- Final calendar invite to be created by recruiting-ops with CoderPad/Zoom links and attached consent doc.
- Interviewers to review rubric in Drive before the call.
- Ops to mark retention policy and ensure recording flagging for hiring review.
